evidence_basis: P0-2C-1 mechanism: recognizing that a data PROVIDER can be technically read (an endpoint responds) is not the same fact as Atlas recognizing that provider as an authoritative portfolio-fact source. No provider_authority_records exist yet -- every provider tuple (including KIS_PAPER_ACCOUNT/KOREA/KRW/kis_paper_domestic_balance) resolves NOT_COMPUTABLE_PROVIDER_AUTHORITY_UNRATIFIED until a separately reviewed, provenance-bound record is added here and RATIFIED. Adding a PROPOSED (not yet RATIFIED) row is a mechanical proposal only and grants no authority by itself -- see identity/candidate_identity_authority_proposal.py's proposal/ratify separation for the same discipline applied at the instrument-identity layer.
